name: Rabine Saturna
summary: You are asked to speak with Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade. The village lies between Felwood and Winterspring, with a path through Timbermaw Hold.

sections.title: A Meeting in Nighthaven
sections.body: Nighthaven is where you are asked to find Rabine Saturna. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, and a path from Timbermaw Hold leads into the region. Speak with Rabine in the village.

faq.q: Where do I find Rabine Saturna?
faq.answer: Rabine Saturna is in the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade.
Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring.
A path out of Timbermaw Hold leads to Moonglade.
